select aka_name.id, name.gender from aka_name, name where name.name = 'Bennett, Jennifer' AND aka_name.surname_pcode >= 'F2' AND name.name_pcode_cf < 'T6565' AND aka_name.name_pcode_cf >= 'B6526' order by aka_name.id ASC, name.gender DESC

select link_type.link, movie_link.id, title.imdb_index, avg(movie_link.id), max(movie_link.movie_id) from link_type, movie_link, title where title.production_year <= 1947 AND movie_link.movie_id > 138672 AND title.season_nr = 13 group by link_type.link, movie_link.id, title.imdb_index order by link_type.link DESC

select cast_info.person_id, char_name.name, role_type.id from role_type JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.role_id = role_type.id JOIN char_name ON char_name.id = cast_info.person_role_id where cast_info.note = '(credit only) (as J)' AND role_type.id <= 10 AND role_type.role = 'cinematographer' order by char_name.name DESC, cast_info.person_id DESC

select title.production_year, title.series_years, name.id, name.name_pcode_nf, cast_info.role_id from kind_type JOIN aka_title ON aka_title.kind_id = kind_type.id JOIN title ON title.id = aka_title.movie_id JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.movie_id = title.id JOIN name ON name.id = cast_info.person_id where aka_title.episode_of_id < 14559 AND aka_title.season_nr < 38 order by title.production_year DESC, title.series_years DESC

SELECT role_type.role, cast_info.movie_id FROM cast_info JOIN role_type ON role_type.id = cast_info.role_id WHERE role_type.id <> 9 AND cast_info.role_id > 6 AND cast_info.movie_id <> 581413 AND cast_info.person_role_id <> 2960 ORDER BY role_type.role ASC

SELECT cast_info.movie_id, char_name.md5sum, role_type.role FROM role_type JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.role_id = role_type.id JOIN char_name ON char_name.id = cast_info.person_role_id WHERE char_name.id <> 2689800 AND char_name.name_pcode_nf <> 'M2454' AND char_name.name < 'Adam First' ORDER BY char_name.md5sum ASC, role_type.role DESC

select company_name.name, movie_info_idx.movie_id, info_type.id, title.id, title.episode_of_id from info_type JOIN movie_info_idx ON movie_info_idx.info_type_id = info_type.id JOIN title ON title.id = movie_info_idx.movie_id JOIN movie_companies ON movie_companies.movie_id = title.id JOIN company_name ON company_name.id = movie_companies.company_id where movie_companies.company_type_id >= 2 AND movie_companies.movie_id >= 1092736 order by company_name.name ASC

SELECT MIN(cn.name) AS from_company, MIN(lt.link) AS movie_link_type, MIN(t.title) AS sequel_movie FROM company_name AS cn, company_type AS ct, keyword AS k, link_type AS lt, movie_companies AS mc, movie_keyword AS mk, movie_link AS ml, title AS t WHERE cn.country_code <> '[pl]' AND (cn.name LIKE '%Film%' OR cn.name LIKE '%Warner%') AND ct.kind = 'production companies' AND k.keyword = 'sequel' AND lt.link LIKE '%follows%' AND mc.note IS NULL AND t.production_year = 1998 AND t.title LIKE '%Money%' AND lt.id = ml.link_type_id AND ml.movie_id = t.id AND t.id = mk.movie_id AND mk.keyword_id = k.id AND t.id = mc.movie_id AND mc.company_type_id = ct.id AND mc.company_id = cn.id AND ml.movie_id = mk.movie_id AND ml.movie_id = mc.movie_id AND mk.movie_id = mc.movie_id

select char_name.id, title.production_year, title.md5sum, title.episode_nr, sum(complete_cast.status_id) from char_name JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.person_role_id = char_name.id JOIN title ON title.id = cast_info.movie_id JOIN complete_cast ON complete_cast.movie_id = title.id where title.md5sum <= '05b0479cac0b762d64a8fbab8106e2e3' AND complete_cast.subject_id > 2 group by title.md5sum, char_name.id, title.episode_nr, title.production_year having sum(complete_cast.status_id) = 2427152

SELECT name.surname_pcode, cast_info.id FROM name JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.person_id = name.id WHERE name.imdb_index > 'XI' AND name.name <> 'Clausi, Gabriel Chula' AND name.name_pcode_nf < 'J6312' AND name.name_pcode_cf <= 'P4524'

SELECT cast_info.nr_order, char_name.name_pcode_nf, name.imdb_index FROM name JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.person_id = name.id JOIN char_name ON char_name.id = cast_info.person_role_id WHERE name.name_pcode_cf >= 'M4264' AND name.id > 2478175 AND char_name.md5sum >= 'b441ad7fd5d415a3a67237cc4766afa6' ORDER BY char_name.name_pcode_nf ASC

SELECT info_type.info, person_info.person_id FROM info_type JOIN person_info ON person_info.info_type_id = info_type.id WHERE info_type.info >= 'LD quality program' AND person_info.info_type_id > 24 AND person_info.person_id = 1866808 AND person_info.info <= 'Yao, Japan'

SELECT title.series_years, movie_info.info_type_id, info_type.info FROM info_type JOIN movie_info ON movie_info.info_type_id = info_type.id JOIN title ON title.id = movie_info.movie_id WHERE title.episode_nr >= 48 AND movie_info.info = '$228,811 (USA) (22 April 1984) (9 screens)' AND title.md5sum < '923f54faa9d41a1dac963b1e4ba1b44b' ORDER BY title.series_years DESC, info_type.info DESC, movie_info.info_type_id DESC

select char_name.id, cast_info.person_role_id, char_name.name from role_type JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.role_id = role_type.id JOIN char_name ON char_name.id = cast_info.person_role_id where char_name.md5sum < 'ecf67a533baf8f0c140455699db8b6ab' AND char_name.imdb_index >= 'II' AND cast_info.person_id = 1430034 order by char_name.id DESC, char_name.name ASC

select title.id, title.imdb_index, title.title, title.season_nr, comp_cast_type.kind from keyword JOIN movie_keyword ON movie_keyword.keyword_id = keyword.id JOIN title ON title.id = movie_keyword.movie_id JOIN complete_cast ON complete_cast.movie_id = title.id JOIN comp_cast_type ON comp_cast_type.id = complete_cast.status_id where keyword.id >= 104859 AND keyword.keyword <= 'civic-pride' AND complete_cast.movie_id >= 1438895 order by title.id DESC, comp_cast_type.kind DESC

SELECT person_info.info, title.phonetic_code, name.md5sum, cast_info.id FROM person_info JOIN name ON name.id = person_info.person_id JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.person_id = name.id JOIN title ON title.id = cast_info.movie_id WHERE name.md5sum > '11fa3165ce58bf3878a4cbb27aed97fd' AND person_info.info <> '1 of 100 the best persons of the century in performing arts,picked by Nation Publisher in year 2000.' AND title.title = '(#2.14)' AND cast_info.role_id <> 11 ORDER BY person_info.info DESC, cast_info.id ASC

SELECT info_type.info, movie_info_idx.movie_id, COUNT(info_type.id) FROM movie_info_idx JOIN info_type ON info_type.id = movie_info_idx.info_type_id WHERE movie_info_idx.movie_id > 1604324 AND movie_info_idx.info < '179' AND movie_info_idx.id > 412529 GROUP BY info_type.info, movie_info_idx.movie_id HAVING COUNT(info_type.id) <> 8 ORDER BY movie_info_idx.movie_id DESC

select title.phonetic_code, title.md5sum, kind_type.id from movie_info_idx JOIN title ON title.id = movie_info_idx.movie_id JOIN kind_type ON kind_type.id = title.kind_id where title.episode_nr < 48 AND movie_info_idx.id < 412529 AND title.kind_id <= 2 AND title.phonetic_code = 'D42' order by kind_type.id DESC, title.phonetic_code ASC

select keyword.phonetic_code, movie_keyword.id, keyword.keyword, count(title.episode_of_id), max(movie_keyword.keyword_id), sum(movie_keyword.id) from keyword JOIN movie_keyword ON movie_keyword.keyword_id = keyword.id JOIN title ON title.id = movie_keyword.movie_id where keyword.id <= 22473 AND movie_keyword.movie_id >= 2217549 AND keyword.keyword = 'year-2078' group by keyword.keyword, movie_keyword.id, keyword.phonetic_code order by movie_keyword.id ASC

SELECT MIN(chn.name) AS voiced_char_name, MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress_name, MIN(t.title) AS voiced_action_movie_jap_eng FROM aka_name AS an, char_name AS chn, cast_info AS ci, company_name AS cn, info_type AS it, keyword AS k, movie_companies AS mc, movie_info AS mi, movie_keyword AS mk, name AS n, role_type AS rt, title AS t WHERE ci.note IN ('(voice)', '(voice: Japanese version)', '(voice) (uncredited)', '(voice: English version)') AND cn.country_code = '[us]' AND it.info = 'release dates' AND k.keyword IN ('hero', 'martial-arts', 'hand-to-hand-combat') AND mi.info IS NOT NULL AND (mi.info LIKE 'Japan:%201%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:%201%') AND n.gender = 'f' AND n.name LIKE '%An%' AND rt.role = 'actress' AND t.production_year > 2010 AND t.id = mi.movie_id AND t.id = mc.movie_id AND t.id = ci.movie_id AND t.id = mk.movie_id AND mc.movie_id = ci.movie_id AND mc.movie_id = mi.movie_id AND mc.movie_id = mk.movie_id AND mi.movie_id = ci.movie_id AND mi.movie_id = mk.movie_id AND ci.movie_id = mk.movie_id AND cn.id = mc.company_id AND it.id = mi.info_type_id AND n.id = ci.person_id AND rt.id = ci.role_id AND n.id = an.person_id AND ci.person_id = an.person_id AND chn.id = ci.person_role_id AND k.id = mk.keyword_id

select title.episode_of_id, movie_link.id, movie_info.movie_id, max(title.episode_nr) from movie_link JOIN title ON title.id = movie_link.movie_id JOIN movie_info ON movie_info.movie_id = title.id where movie_info.info_type_id < 43 AND title.id > 724807 AND title.series_years >= '2009-????' group by title.episode_of_id, movie_link.id, movie_info.movie_id having max(title.episode_nr) >= 237

select cast_info.person_role_id, char_name.name, role_type.id from role_type JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.role_id = role_type.id JOIN char_name ON char_name.id = cast_info.person_role_id where char_name.imdb_index = 'D' AND role_type.id <= 10 AND cast_info.id = 25682130 order by char_name.name DESC, role_type.id DESC

select name.id, name.md5sum, aka_name.person_id, name.surname_pcode from aka_name JOIN name ON name.id = aka_name.person_id JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.person_id = name.id JOIN role_type ON role_type.id = cast_info.role_id where name.name_pcode_nf = 'N3531' AND cast_info.person_id > 1261574 AND cast_info.nr_order <= 69 AND role_type.id >= 9

SELECT cast_info.person_role_id, movie_link.linked_movie_id, title.series_years FROM movie_link JOIN title ON title.id = movie_link.movie_id JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.movie_id = title.id WHERE title.episode_nr = 29 AND title.title <= 'Een jaar later' AND cast_info.movie_id <= 1261456 ORDER BY movie_link.linked_movie_id DESC, title.series_years ASC

SELECT person_info.info, name.surname_pcode, cast_info.movie_id, info_type.id FROM info_type JOIN person_info ON person_info.info_type_id = info_type.id JOIN name ON name.id = person_info.person_id JOIN cast_info ON cast_info.person_id = name.id WHERE name.name = 'Goury, Vincent' AND person_info.note = 'Anonymous' AND name.gender <= 'm' AND person_info.info_type_id <> 29 ORDER BY cast_info.movie_id DESC, info_type.id DESC, person_info.info ASC, name.surname_pcode DESC
